in_marathi.name: Asin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asini means 'fearless' in Sanskrit. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asana' which means 'seat' or 'position'. Asini was the name of a queen in Hindu mythology who was known for her fearlessness and courage.
